Name: Jehoiachin, King of Judah
Summary: Jehoiachin reigned three months, surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar, and was carried to Babylon with his mother and officers; thirty-seven years later Evil-Merodach released him from prison and set his seat above the other captive kings.
KeyStory: Jehoiachin surrenders and is later released in Babylon.
RelatedPeople: King Nebuchadnezzar; Evil-Merodach, King of Babylon; Nehushta, Mother of Jehoiachin; Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Zedekiah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Even in exile, God's mercy finds the prisoner: Jehoiachin's release is a small dawn before the return.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
